<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_Inspection"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/energy-drink-bottling-inspection">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Inspection" name="Inspection of an Energy Drink Bottling Machine" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Inspection">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_User" name="User">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Inspection</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterMachineType</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterSerialNumber</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AnswerInspectionQuestions</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PressButtons</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AnswerAdditionalQuestions</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Inspection</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Application" name="Application">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CollectMachineValues</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DisplayMachineValues</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AdditionalQuestions</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AdditionalQuestionsMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Inspection" name="Begin inspection">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_EnterType</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterMachineType" name="Enter machine type">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_EnterType</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EnterType_EnterSerial</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterSerialNumber" name="Enter serial number">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EnterType_EnterSerial</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EnterSerial_AnswerQuestions</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AnswerInspectionQuestions" name="Answer inspection questions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EnterSerial_AnswerQuestions</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AnswerQuestions_PressButtons</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PressButtons" name="Press inspection buttons">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AnswerQuestions_PressButtons</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PressButtons_CollectValues</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CollectMachineValues" name="Collect values from machine">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PressButtons_CollectValues</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CollectValues_Display</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_DisplayMachineValues" name="Display collected values">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CollectValues_Display</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DisplayValues_Decision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions" name="Are additional questions required?" default="Flow_NoAdditionalQuestions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DisplayValues_Decision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalQuestionsRequired</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoAdditionalQuestions</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AnswerAdditionalQuestions" name="Answer additional questions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalQuestionsRequired</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalQuestions_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalQuestionsMerge" name="Continue inspection">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalQuestions_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoAdditionalQuestions</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Merge_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Inspection" name="Inspection complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Merge_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_EnterType" sourceRef="Start_Inspection" targetRef="Task_EnterMachineType"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterType_EnterSerial" sourceRef="Task_EnterMachineType" targetRef="Task_EnterSerialNumber"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterSerial_AnswerQuestions" sourceRef="Task_EnterSerialNumber" targetRef="Task_AnswerInspectionQuestions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AnswerQuestions_PressButtons" sourceRef="Task_AnswerInspectionQuestions" targetRef="Task_PressButtons"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PressButtons_CollectValues" sourceRef="Task_PressButtons" targetRef="Task_CollectMachineValues"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CollectValues_Display" sourceRef="Task_CollectMachineValues" targetRef="Task_DisplayMachineValues"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DisplayValues_Decision" sourceRef="Task_DisplayMachineValues" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalQuestionsRequired" name="Additional questions required" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions" targetRef="Task_AnswerAdditionalQuestions">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">resultsRequireAdditionalQuestions</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAdditionalQuestions" name="No additional questions" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestionsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalQuestions_Merge" sourceRef="Task_AnswerAdditionalQuestions" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestionsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_End" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestionsMerge" targetRef="End_Inspection"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
